repos_data.description: InfraNode - free, key-less open-data REST API + MCP server for 84 German cities

repo_meta_data.description: The German Real-Time Mobility Context Platform for AI: live motorways, rail and public transport, EV charging, fuel, parking and weather warnings in any AI assistant. No API key, no sign-up. Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.viafrei.de/mcp, legacy SSE: https://mcp.viafrei.de/sse. This repo is the stdio bridge (npx viafrei).
